Class DemoDriver

java.lang.Object
chess.console.DemoDriver
public final class DemoDriver extends Object
Non-interactive demonstration driver that runs labeled test scenarios against Game and InputParser, printing the input, the expected result, the observed result, and PASS/FAIL for each check.

The scenarios include every case suggested in the assignment plus boundary cases for each piece type. The game is reset before each scenario. Run it with java -cp out chess.console.DemoDriver.
